card.fact_statement: The Israeli intelligence agency was responsible for integrating explosives into the devices for the 2024 Lebanon electronic device attacks.
card.source_span: The Israeli intelligence agency Mossad had secretly manufactured and integrated the explosive PETN into the devices

target_qa_variants.question: Quelle organisation était responsable de l'intégration d'explosifs dans les appareils lors des attaques aux appareils électroniques au Liban en 2024 ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The Israeli intelligence agency Mossad had secretly manufactured and integrated the explosive PETN into the devices
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Israeli intelligence agency' literally to 'Agence de renseignement israélienne'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which organization was responsible for integrating explosives into the devices during the attacks on electronic devices in Lebanon in 2024?
